description: Defines the class 'precoding_weight_matrix' for managing complex precoding matrices with various constructors, accessors, and operators. Includes external dependencies and constants related to precoding.

classes.name: precoding_weight_matrix
classes.description: Class representing a matrix of complex precoding weights, with methods for construction, access, comparison, and scaling.

methods.name: precoding_weight_matrix()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an empty precoding matrix.

methods.name: precoding_weight_matrix(unsigned nof_layers, unsigned nof_ports)
methods.description: Constructs a matrix with specified layers and ports, initializing all coefficients to zero.

methods.name: precoding_weight_matrix(const std::initializer_list<cf_t>& weights, unsigned nof_layers, unsigned nof_ports)
methods.description: Constructs a matrix with specified weights, layers, and ports.

methods.name: precoding_weight_matrix(span<const cf_t> weights, unsigned nof_layers, unsigned nof_ports)
methods.description: Constructs a matrix with specified weights, layers, and ports, copying weights into internal storage.

methods.name: operator==(const precoding_weight_matrix& other) const
methods.description: Checks if two matrices are exactly equal.

methods.name: operator!=(const precoding_weight_matrix& other) const
methods.description: Checks if two matrices are not equal.

methods.name: get_port_coefficients(unsigned i_port) const
methods.description: Returns a read-only view of weights for a specific port.

methods.name: get_port_coefficients(unsigned i_port)
methods.description: Returns a modifiable view of weights for a specific port.

methods.name: set_coefficient(cf_t coefficient, unsigned i_layer, unsigned i_port)
operator*=(float scale)
